items.text: Angel Oakley is a former Winfield Village Trustee and the owner of a marketing and communications firm. She holds a B.A. from Judson University and a Master's in Organizational Leadership. She is a former board member of Children's Health Defense, a vaccine-skeptic group founded by Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and has worked as a medical cannabis educator and CBD broker. She describes herself as a conservative moderate.

sentences.text: Angel Oakley is a former Winfield Village Trustee and the owner of a marketing and communications firm.
She holds a B.A. from Judson University and a Master's in Organizational Leadership.
She is a former board member of Children's Health Defense, a vaccine-skeptic group founded by Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and has worked as a medical cannabis educator and CBD broker.
She describes herself as a conservative moderate.

items.text: Oakley told the Chicago Tribune she supports tracking and auditing every dollar Congress spends and posting it online for taxpayers to review. Her campaign says she would reduce federal spending, lower taxes on working families, cut regulations for small businesses, and expand workforce training. She advocates for securing the border, reforming immigration, ending foreign wars, refocusing the military on homeland defense, and ending the surveillance state. Her campaign platform includes expanding parental involvement in schools, promoting STEM education, auditing federal education programs, and limiting federal involvement in local education. She supports cleaning up pollution and promoting regenerative agriculture and local food production.
